023package org.opt4j.gatekeeper;
024
025import com.google.inject.Singleton;
026import com.google.inject.TypeLiteral;
027import org.opt4j.core.config.Icons;
028import org.opt4j.core.config.annotations.Icon;
029import org.opt4j.core.config.annotations.Info;
030import org.opt4j.core.config.annotations.Order;
031import org.opt4j.core.config.annotations.Parent;
032import org.opt4j.core.problem.Evaluator;
033import org.opt4j.core.start.Constant;
034import org.opt4j.core.start.Opt4JModule;
035import org.opt4j.gatekeeper.djl.DjlDominancePredictor;
036
037@Parent(NeuralGatekeeper.class)
038@Icon(Icons.PUZZLE_BLUE)
039@Info("<html><b>Configures the Neural Gatekeeper for Predictive Skipping.</b><br><br>"
040        + "<font color='red'><b>WARNING: No other logger with the same output file should be active!</b></font><br><br>"
041        + "<b>Aggressive Profile (Default):</b><br>"
042        + "Start Iteration = 25 | Exploration = 0.2 | Learning Rate = 0.001 | Threshold = 0.8 | Penalty = 1.0<br><br>"
043        + "<b>Conservative Profile:</b><br>"
044        + "Start Iteration = 50 | Exploration = 0.2 | Learning Rate = 0.0005 | Threshold = 0.95 | Penalty = 10.0</html>")
045public class NeuralGatekeeperModule extends Opt4JModule {
046
047    @Info("Enable predictive skipping of evaluations.")
048    @Order(1)
049    @Constant(value = "enablePredictiveSkipping", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
050    protected boolean enablePredictiveSkipping = true;
051
052    @Info("Iteration at which to start predicting and skipping evaluations.")
053    @Order(2)
054    @Constant(value = "predictionStartIteration", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
055    protected int predictionStartIteration = 25;
056
057    @Info("Probability to run a real evaluation even if a skip was predicted (for forced exploration).")
058    @Order(3)
059    @Constant(value = "explorationProbability", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
060    protected double explorationProbability = 0.2;
061
062    @Info("Number of hidden layers in the neural network.")
063    @Order(4)
064    @Constant(value = "hiddenLayerCount", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
065    protected int hiddenLayerCount = 2;
066
067    @Info("Number of units in the hidden layers.")
068    @Order(5)
069    @Constant(value = "hiddenLayerSize", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
070    protected int hiddenLayerSize = 200;
071
072    @Info("Learning rate for the neural network optimizer.")
073    @Order(6)
074    @Constant(value = "learningRate", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
075    protected double learningRate = 0.001;
076
077    @Info("Probability threshold for predicting dominance.")
078    @Order(7)
079    @Constant(value = "predictionThreshold", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
080    protected double predictionThreshold = 0.8;
081
082    @Info("Penalty multiplier for false positives during training.")
083    @Order(8)
084    @Constant(value = "falsePositivePenalty", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
085    protected double falsePositivePenalty = 1.0;
086
087    @Info("Maximum number of training pairs per generation. Use -1 to use the entire archive.")
088    @Order(9)
089    @Constant(value = "maxArchiveSamplesForTraining", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
090    protected int maxArchiveSamplesForTraining = -1;
091
092    @Info("Batch size used for training the neural network.")
093    @Order(10)
094    @Constant(value = "batchSize", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
095    protected int batchSize = 1024;
096
097    @Info("The filename for the main run output TSV (correct evaluation count).")
098    @Order(11)
099    @Constant(value = "tsvFilename", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
100    protected String tsvFilename = "run.tsv";
101
102    @Info("The filename for the accuracy output TSV.")
103    @Order(12)
104    @Constant(value = "accuracyFilename", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
105    protected String accuracyFilename = "accuracy.tsv";
106
107    @Info("Enable GPU acceleration for the neural network (requires CUDA).")
108    @Order(13)
109    @Constant(value = "useGpu", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class)
110    protected boolean useGpu = false;
111
112
113    public boolean isEnablePredictiveSkipping() {
114        return enablePredictiveSkipping;
115    }
116
117    public void setEnablePredictiveSkipping(boolean enablePredictiveSkipping) {
118        this.enablePredictiveSkipping = enablePredictiveSkipping;
119    }
120
121    public int getPredictionStartIteration() {
122        return predictionStartIteration;
123    }
124
125    public void setPredictionStartIteration(int predictionStartIteration) {
126        this.predictionStartIteration = predictionStartIteration;
127    }
128
129    public double getExplorationProbability() {
130        return explorationProbability;
131    }
132
133    public void setExplorationProbability(double explorationProbability) {
134        this.explorationProbability = explorationProbability;
135    }
136
137    public int getHiddenLayerCount() {
138        return hiddenLayerCount;
139    }
140
141    public void setHiddenLayerCount(int hiddenLayerCount) {
142        this.hiddenLayerCount = hiddenLayerCount;
143    }
144
145    public int getHiddenLayerSize() {
146        return hiddenLayerSize;
147    }
148
149    public void setHiddenLayerSize(int hiddenLayerSize) {
150        this.hiddenLayerSize = hiddenLayerSize;
151    }
152
153    public double getLearningRate() {
154        return learningRate;
155    }
156
157    public void setLearningRate(double learningRate) {
158        this.learningRate = learningRate;
159    }
160
161    public double getPredictionThreshold() {
162        return predictionThreshold;
163    }
164
165    public void setPredictionThreshold(double predictionThreshold) {
166        this.predictionThreshold = predictionThreshold;
167    }
168
169    public double getFalsePositivePenalty() {
170        return falsePositivePenalty;
171    }
172
173    public void setFalsePositivePenalty(double falsePositivePenalty) {
174        this.falsePositivePenalty = falsePositivePenalty;
175    }
176
177    public int getMaxArchiveSamplesForTraining() {
178        return maxArchiveSamplesForTraining;
179    }
180
181    public void setMaxArchiveSamplesForTraining(int maxArchiveSamplesForTraining) {
182        this.maxArchiveSamplesForTraining = maxArchiveSamplesForTraining;
183    }
184
185    public int getBatchSize() {
186        return batchSize;
187    }
188
189    public void setBatchSize(int batchSize) {
190        this.batchSize = batchSize;
191    }
192
193    public String getTsvFilename() {
194        return tsvFilename;
195    }
196
197    public void setTsvFilename(String tsvFilename) {
198        this.tsvFilename = tsvFilename;
199    }
200
201    public String getAccuracyFilename() {
202        return accuracyFilename;
203    }
204
205    public void setAccuracyFilename(String accuracyFilename) {
206        this.accuracyFilename = accuracyFilename;
207    }
208
209    public boolean isUseGpu() {
210        return useGpu;
211    }
212
213    public void setUseGpu(boolean useGpu) {
214        this.useGpu = useGpu;
215    }
216
217
218    @Override
219    protected void config() {
220        // Bind Core Manager
221        bind(DominancePredictionManager.class).in(Singleton.class);
222
223        // Intercept Evaluator
224        bind(new TypeLiteral<Evaluator<Object>>() {}).to(PredictiveEvaluator.class).in(Singleton.class);
225
226        // Add the Training Listener
227        bind(GatekeeperTrainingListener.class).in(Singleton.class);
228        addOptimizerIterationListener(GatekeeperTrainingListener.class);
229        addOptimizerStateListener(GatekeeperTrainingListener.class);
230
231        bind(EvaluationLogger.class).in(Singleton.class);
232        addOptimizerIterationListener(EvaluationLogger.class);
233        addOptimizerStateListener(EvaluationLogger.class);
234
235        // Bind DJL Implementation to the Interface
236        bind(GatekeeperModel.class).to(DjlDominancePredictor.class).in(Singleton.class);
237    }
238}
